prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical celebratory 4-panel anime manga illustration about a cute moon-themed princess reacting to a video view count milestone.

Canvas: Tall vertical webcomic format, about 9:16 aspect ratio, with four stacked rectangular panels separated by thick dark borders. Use bright, polished gpt-image-2 style anime rendering, clean line art, soft gradients, expressive chibi proportions, and energetic manga effects.

Main character: A small chibi anime princess with short bobbed blue-purple hair, large sparkling blue eyes with star highlights, rosy cheeks, and a gold tiara topped with a blue heart gem. She wears a royal purple-blue winter princess outfit: cape/robe with gold trim and star patterns, fluffy white fur collar and cuffs, decorative bow at the chest, layered white skirt, black thigh-high socks, and blue shoes. Keep her design consistent across all four panels.

Panel count and layout: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top panel: Cozy room at night with a window showing a red moon in a starry sky, purple curtains, snowflake decorations, a mug on the desk, a smartphone in the character’s hand, and a purple book/card on the right. The character looks curious and thoughtful while checking the phone. Add one large round speech bubble on the left containing the text RED MOON\n再生数\nいくつかな？. Include a small purple question mark near the right side.
2. Second panel: Extreme close-up of the character’s surprised face, mouth open, eyes wide, with a purple radial speed-line background. Add exactly one jagged speech bubble on the left containing え!?!?. Add one yellow surprise sparkle near the bubble.
3. Third panel: The character is seated or bouncing in shock, both hands raised, mouth open, small blue sweat-drop marks near her head, red/pink radial burst background. Add exactly one large jagged speech bubble occupying the left half, with huge bold red milestone text 1.2万\n再生ええええ; make the number the largest element in the panel.
4. Bottom panel: Full-body joyful celebration pose, the character leaps forward with both arms spread wide, eyes closed in a huge smile. Background shows the large red moon outside the broken-looking panel frame, confetti, sparkles, snowflakes, paper shards, and energetic celebratory lines. Add exactly one large cloud-shaped speech bubble in the lower-left containing oversized bold red text ありがとうー！.

Visual style: Cute Japanese anime/manga chibi illustration, saturated purples and reds, glossy highlights, soft blush, dynamic comic motion lines, festive atmosphere, crisp outlines, high-detail clothing ornaments, playful celebratory tone.

Constraints: Preserve exactly four panels and exactly four main speech bubbles, one per panel. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text. Keep all visible text large, legible, and integrated into manga-style bubbles.
